en.title: Tom Holland & Zendaya Love Insomniac's Spider-Man Games, Studio Invites Them Over
en.summary: The stars of the upcoming Spider-Man: Brand New Day film have revealed their deep affection for Insomniac's acclaimed PlayStation series. Their praise has earned them an invitation to visit the game developer's studio.
en.body:
It's no secret that **Tom Holland** and **Zendaya** are the reigning king and queen of the Spider-Man cinematic universe. But it turns out, their passion for the web-slinger extends beyond the silver screen and deep into the digital realm. In a recent chat with IGN Benelux, the duo confessed to being massive fans of **Insomniac Games'** critically lauded PlayStation series, including **Marvel's Spider-Man** and **Marvel's Spider-Man 2**. When asked if the games served as inspiration for sequences in their upcoming film, **Spider-Man: Brand New Day**, Holland enthusiastically stated, "We love the games, the games are absolutely sensational." Zendaya chimed in with a relatable confession about her own gaming prowess, admitting, "I'm not very good at playing video games. I get very frustrated because I want to play it all by myself, and he'll try to come [help me]."

Their shared gaming adventures even led to a memorable challenge in **Marvel's Spider-Man 2**. Zendaya recounted her struggles with a particular section where Mary Jane Watson is possessed by a symbiote and transforms into the villainous Scream. "Ultimately, Holland had to help her with it," she revealed, adding a touch of playful exasperation to her admission. This isn't the first time Holland has publicly lauded Insomniac's work; back in 2021, he shared that Sony had provided him with a PS5 for **Spider-Man: No Way Home** promotions, and he thoroughly enjoyed diving into the game. He even noted that the development team had incorporated a specific move from the game into the film, which fans widely believe to be the iconic aerial flip and slam against the Green Goblin.

## A Nod from the Developers

This genuine admiration from the stars has not gone unnoticed by the talented team at **Insomniac Games**. Following their comments during the **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** press tour, the studio extended a warm invitation to **Tom Holland** and **Zendaya** to visit their development headquarters. While it remains to be seen if the actors will take up the offer, such a visit would undoubtedly be a treat for both the stars and the passionate community that devours both the games and the films. It also presents a fantastic opportunity to celebrate the upcoming addition of the **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** suit to **Marvel's Spider-Man 2**, slated for release next month.

## The Fan Connection

The connection between the on-screen Peter Parker and MJ and their virtual counterparts is more than just professional; it's a genuine fan-to-creator appreciation loop. **Tom Holland** and **Zendaya**'s candid praise reinforces the impact **Insomniac's** storytelling and gameplay have had, resonating with the very actors who bring these characters to life in a different medium. Fans have eagerly followed their interactions, particularly their joint appearances at promotional events like the **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** photocall in Madrid on June 15, 2026. The shared enthusiasm fuels the already immense excitement for both the film and the ongoing evolution of the **Marvel's Spider-Man** video game universe, proving that for these actors, being Spider-Man is a role they truly *live*.

## What's Next

With the **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** film on the horizon and the new suit arriving in **Marvel's Spider-Man 2** next month, the web of excitement continues to expand. Fans will be watching closely to see if Holland and Zendaya make good on the studio visit and what other crossover moments might emerge between the film and game universes.

Su entusiasmo les ha valido una invitación para visitar el estudio de desarrollo. es.body:
No es un secreto que **Tom Holland** y **Zendaya** son los reyes indiscutibles del universo cinematográfico de Spider-Man. Pero lo que puede sorprender es que su pasión por el personaje se extiende más allá de la gran pantalla y llega al mundo digital. En una charla reciente con IGN Benelux, la pareja confesó ser fanáticos incondicionales de la aclamada serie de **Insomniac Games** para PlayStation, que incluye **Marvel's Spider-Man** y **Marvel's Spider-Man 2**. Cuando se les preguntó si los juegos les habían servido de inspiración para secuencias en su próxima película, **Spider-Man: Brand New Day**, Holland expresó su entusiasmo: > "Amamos los juegos, son absolutamente sensacionales". Zendaya compartió una confesión relatable sobre su propia habilidad para los videojuegos, admitiendo: > "No soy muy buena jugando videojuegos. Me frustra mucho porque quiero jugar sola, y él intenta ayudarme".

## Una invitación del estudio

Su admiración genuina no ha pasado desapercibida para el talentoso equipo de **Insomniac Games**. Tras sus comentarios durante la gira de prensa de **Spider-Man: Brand New Day**, el estudio extendió una cálida invitación a **Tom Holland** y **Zendaya** para visitar su sede de desarrollo. Aunque aún no se sabe si los actores aceptarán la oferta, una visita de este tipo sería sin duda un regalo para ambos, los actores y la apasionada comunidad que consume tanto los juegos como las películas. También presenta una oportunidad fantástica para celebrar la próxima incorporación del traje de **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** a **Marvel's Spider-Man 2**, programada para su lanzamiento el próximo mes.

## La conexión con los fans

La conexión entre el Peter Parker y la MJ de la pantalla y sus contrapartes virtuales es más que profesional; es un círculo de admiración auténtico entre fanáticos y creadores. La alabanza sincera de **Tom Holland** y **Zendaya** refuerza el impacto que la narrativa y el juego de **Insomniac** han tenido, resonando con los mismos actores que dan vida a estos personajes en un medio diferente. Los fanáticos han seguido con interés sus interacciones, especialmente sus apariciones conjuntas en eventos promocionales como la sesión de fotos de **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** en Madrid el 15 de junio de 2026. El entusiasmo compartido alimenta la ya inmensa emoción por tanto la película como la evolución continua del universo de videojuegos **Marvel's Spider-Man**, demostrando que para estos actores, ser Spider-Man es un papel que verdaderamente *viven*.

## Próximos Pasos

Con la película **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** en el horizonte y el nuevo traje llegando a **Marvel's Spider-Man 2** el próximo mes, la red de emoción sigue expandiéndose. Los fanáticos estarán atentos para ver si Holland y Zendaya cumplen con la visita al estudio y qué otros momentos de cruzamiento podrían surgir entre los universos de la película y los juegos.

content_raw: Spider-Man: Brand New Day stars Tom Holland and Zendaya really enjoy Insomniac Games' Spider-Man games. In a recent interview with IGN Benelux , Holland and Zendaya were asked whether or not the games were used as inspiration for certain sequences in Spider-Man: Brand New Day. Although they didn't really answer the question directly, they did note that they're big fans of the game. "We love the games, the games are absolutely sensational," said Holland. "I'm not very good at playing video games. I get very frustrated because I want to play it all by myself, and he'll try to come [help me]," added Zendaya. The two then explained how Zendaya had troubles with a section in Marvel's Spider-Man 2. In the back half of the game, Mary Jane Watson gets taken over by a symbiote and turns into a villainous monster known as Scream. Zendaya noted that she had a lot of trouble with that portion in the game and, ultimately, Holland had to help her with it. This isn't the first time Holland has expressed his love for Insomniac's Spider-Man games. When promoting Spider-Man: No Way Home in 2021, Holland noted that Sony gave him a PS5 to play and he really enjoyed playing it. He stated that the team even copied one move from the game and added it into the film. Fans believe that the move is when Peter flips Green Goblin through the air before slamming him back into the ground, using his webs to propel them. After seeing Holland and Zendaya's comments about the games during the Brand New Day promo, Insomniac Games extended an invitation to have the two stars come visit the studio. Whether or not that actually happens remains to be seen, but it would be a great way to help promote the Brand New Day suit being added to Marvel's Spider-Man 2 next month . Spider-Man: Brand New Day swings into cinemas on July 31st. Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more.
